targets.rawSql:
WITH GatewayReceptions AS (
  -- 1. Grab every reception, tag it with the region/channel, and capture the gateway name
  SELECT
    m.packet_id,
    m.time,
    m.portnum,
    REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') AS sender_id,
    (m.hop_start - m.hop_limit) AS hops_taken,
    NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(substring(g.last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 'US/AZ/', '')), '') AS region,
    NULLIF(substring(g.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/![a-fA-F0-9]+$'), '') AS channel,
    
    -- 📍 Capture the cleanest identifier for the gateway up front
    COALESCE(g.long_name, REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '')) AS gateway_name

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
  LEFT JOIN node_details g ON REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(g.node_id::text, '!', '')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time)
    AND m.portnum IN (${message_type:singlequote})
    AND g.last_heard_topic IS NOT NULL
),
RankedReceptions AS (
  -- 2. Rank the gateways: Closest to sender (lowest hops) and earliest time wins #1
  SELECT 
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY packet_id ORDER BY hops_taken ASC, time ASC) as rx_rank
  FROM GatewayReceptions
  WHERE region IS NOT NULL 
    AND channel IN (${channel:singlequote})
),
Origin AS (
  -- 3A. The first gateway to hear it establishes the Source Region
  SELECT * FROM RankedReceptions WHERE rx_rank = 1
),
Destinations AS (
  -- 3B. Aggregate all gateways in the destination region that caught the same packet
  SELECT 
    packet_id,
    region,
    MIN(time) as arrival_time,
    MIN(hops_taken) as min_dest_hops,
    
    -- 📍 String together all unique gateways in this destination region that heard it
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT gateway_name, ', ') AS dest_gateways

  FROM RankedReceptions
  WHERE rx_rank > 1
  GROUP BY packet_id, region
)

-- 4. Bring the journey together
SELECT
  o.time AS "Origin Time",
  o.packet_id::text AS "Packet ID",
  COALESCE(sn.long_name, o.sender_id) AS "Sender Node",
  o.portnum AS "Message Type",
  o.channel AS "Channel",
  
  -- The Journey Columns
  o.region AS "Source",
  '➡️' AS "Dir",
  d.region AS "Destination",
  
  -- 📍 The new column listing every destination receiver
  d.dest_gateways AS "Destination Gateways",
  
  -- Transit Metrics
  d.min_dest_hops - o.hops_taken AS "Hops Between Regions",
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d.arrival_time - o.time))::numeric, 2) AS "Transit Delay (s)"

FROM Origin o
JOIN Destinations d ON o.packet_id = d.packet_id 
  AND o.region != d.region 

LEFT JOIN node_details sn ON o.sender_id = REPLACE(sn.node_id::text, '!', '')

WHERE o.region IN (${source_region:singlequote})
  AND d.region IN (${destination_region:singlequote})

ORDER BY o.time DESC;

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(REPLACE(substring(last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 'US/AZ/', '')) AS region
FROM node_details
WHERE last_heard_topic IS NOT NULL 
  AND substring(last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/') != ''
ORDER BY region ASC;
